response.sql: WITH pairs AS (SELECT s.transref AS transref, t.tradekind AS tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_ovr FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), overall AS (SELECT AVG(s.optvolrt) AS overall_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg), dev AS (SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.avg_ovr, ABS(p.avg_ovr - o.overall_avg) AS deviation FROM pairs p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL), typed AS (SELECT d.*, AVG(d.deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY d.tradekind) AS type_avg_dev FROM dev d WHERE d.tradekind IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT tradekind, avg_ovr, deviation, deviation - type_avg_dev AS excess FROM typed WHERE deviation > type_avg_dev) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_ovr) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind
